```{r}
#read in Johnson Creek RST estimates
year <- seq(2021, 2024, by = 1)

johtrp <- setNames(
  lapply(year, function(y) readRDS(paste0("output/estimates/summer_JOHTRP_", y, ".RDS"))),
  paste0("johtrp_", year)
)

#read in 2025 estimates
#parr_2025 <- readRDS("output/estimates/parr_estimates_multiple_2025_OGR.RDS")

#read in 2021 - 2024 parr estimates

year <- seq(2021, 2025, by = 1)
parr_estimates <- setNames(
  lapply(year, function(y) readRDS(paste0("output/estimates/parr", y, ".RDS"))),
  paste0("estimates_", year)
)

#and ch for 2021 - 2024
ch_parr <- setNames(
  lapply(year, function(y) readRDS(paste0("output/estimates/ch_parr_", y, ".RDS"))),
  paste0("ch_parr_", year)
)


```

```{r}

#define MPGS
gri <- c("BEAR6C", "HURRIC", "WALLOR", "CATHEC", "LOSTIR", "IMNAHR", "MINAMR", "GRAND2", "CATCNF", "CATCSF", "CATHEC", "MINAMR") 
sf_sal <- c("BURNLC", "GROUSC", "JOHNSC", "LAKEC", "SAEFSF", "SALRSF", "SECESR", "SUMITC", "KNOXB")
mf_sal <- c("CHAMBC", "MARSHC", "CAPEHC", "BEARVC", "ELKC", "LOONC", "VALEYC", "BIG2C")
wet_clear <- c("LOLOC") 
dry_clear <- c("NEWSOC", "REDR", "AMERR", "CROOKR")


#estimates

#survival
survival_list <- map(parr_estimates, ~ .x$phi)
survival_df <- bind_rows(survival_list, .id = "year") %>%
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, -4)) %>%
  mutate(mark_season = str_extract(release_group, "(?<=_).*")) %>%
  mutate(release_group = str_extract(release_group, "^[^_]+")) %>%
  mutate(mark_season = if_else(is.na(mark_season), "Summer", mark_season)) %>%
  mutate(mpg = case_when(
    `release_group` %in% gri  ~ "Grande Ronde/Imnaha",
    `release_group` %in% sf_sal   ~ "SF Salmon",
    `release_group` %in% mf_sal ~ "MF Salmon",
    `release_group` %in% wet_clear    ~ "Wet Clearwater", 
    `release_group` %in% dry_clear ~ "Dry Clearwater"))

#detection
detection_list <- map(parr_estimates, ~ .x$p)
detection_df <- bind_rows(detection_list, .id = "year") %>%
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, -4))

#cumulative survival
cumulative_list <- map(parr_estimates, ~ .x$cum_phi)
cumulative_df <- bind_rows(cumulative_list, .id = "year") %>%
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, -4)) %>%
  mutate(mark_season = str_extract(release_group, "(?<=_).*")) %>%
  mutate(release_group = str_extract(release_group, "^[^_]+")) %>%
  mutate(mark_season = if_else(is.na(mark_season), "Summer", mark_season)) %>%
  mutate(mpg = case_when(
    `release_group` %in% gri  ~ "Grande Ronde/Imnaha",
    `release_group` %in% sf_sal   ~ "SF Salmon",
    `release_group` %in% mf_sal ~ "MF Salmon",
    `release_group` %in% wet_clear    ~ "Wet Clearwater", 
    `release_group` %in% dry_clear ~ "Dry Clearwater"))


obs_sites <- unique(detection_df$site)
```

#map showing 2025 sites

mrr_meta <- queryMRRMeta()

flowline <- readRDS("shiny/shiny_data/snake_river_flowline_NHD.RDS")

watershed_boundary <- huc4 %>% filter(name == "Lower Snake")

#get mark files to pull lat/long
activity <- "parr"
tag_yr = 2025

file_df <- check_mark_groups_tag_yr(activity = activity, tag_year = tag_yr)

# we can only run survivals if we have interrogation or complete tag history information
mark_groups <- file_df %>% filter(cth_exists)

mark_df <- map_df(mark_groups$mark_file,
                    ~readRDS(file.path(file_path, .)))

coords <- mark_df %>%
    select(release_site, location_latitude, location_longitude, location_rkmext) %>%
    distinct() %>% 
    mutate(year = tag_yr)

                    "CATCSF", 45.11681, -117.63871, 
                    "CATHEC", 45.15179, -117.73878, 
                    "GRAND2", 45.11310, -118.36519,

#Marsh 44.39641, -115.16912
#Chamberlin 45.37165, -115.19030

         location_longitude = as.character(location_longitude)) %>%
  rows_update(missing_coords, by = "release_site") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(location_longitude))

mrr_sites <- coords %>%
  mutate(type = "MRR") %>%
  select(-year, -location_rkmext) %>%
  rename(site_code = release_site) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("location_longitude", "location_latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = TRUE
  )  

#"mean" release location for labeling
mean_location <- coords %>%
  mutate(location_latitude = as.numeric(location_latitude), 
         location_longitude = as.numeric(location_longitude)) %>%
  group_by(release_site) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(location_longitude)) %>%
  summarise(longitude = mean(location_longitude), latitude = mean(location_latitude)) %>%
  rename(site_code = release_site)  %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  mutate(type = "MRR")

iptds_sf = int_meta |>
  select(
    site_code = siteCode,
    #name,
    latitude,
    longitude
  ) |> 
  filter(site_code %in% c(obs_sites, "IR1", "IR2", "LC1", "LC2", "SC1", "SC2")) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "INT")

#coords for lower granite

LGR_coord <- mrr_meta %>%
  filter(siteCode == "LGR") %>%
  select(siteCode, latitude, longitude) %>%
  mutate(type = "INT") %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = TRUE
  ) %>%
  rename(site_code = siteCode)

#combine mrr and iptds sites for better labeling
sites_complete <- rbind(iptds_sf, mean_location, LGR_coord)

states <- states(cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(flowline)) %>%
  filter(STUSPS %in% c("ID", "WA", "OR"))

map <- ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = watershed_boundary, color = "black", fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = subset(flowline, streamorde > 1), color = "steelblue3", aes(linewidth = streamorde)) +
  geom_sf(data = states, fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = sites_complete, size = 3, aes(fill = type), shape = 21) + 
  geom_sf_label_repel(data = sites_complete, aes(label = site_code), alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.5, 1)) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        axis.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.85), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-119, -113), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(43.7, 47.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  guides(linewidth = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red3", "gold2"), name = "Type", labels = c("Detection site", "Tagging site")) + 
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", text_cex = 0.9, style = "ticks") + 
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", pad_y = unit(10, "mm"), 
                         style = north_arrow_orienteering(), 
                         width = unit(10, "mm"), height = unit(10, "mm"))

```{r}
#compare Johnson Creek RST estimates to JC parr tagging estimates
johtrp_phi_list <- map(johtrp, "phi")
johtrp_phi_df <- bind_rows(johtrp_phi_list, .id = "year") %>%
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, -4))

parr_2025 <- parr_estimates$estimates_2025

johnsc_phi <- parr_2025$phi %>%
  filter(release_group == "JOHNSC_Summer") %>%
  mutate(year = 2025)

johnsc_comparison <- rbind(johtrp_phi_df, johnsc_phi)

fig_johnson_creek <- johnsc_comparison %>%
  mutate(from_site = if_else(from_site == "JOHTRP", "JOHNSC", from_site)) %>%
  unite(col = "int_label", from_site, to_site, sep = " to ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(interval = as.numeric(interval)) %>%
    mutate(int_label = fct_reorder(int_label, interval)) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = int_label, y = phi)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = year, shape = release_group), size = 5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl, color = year), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  plot_theme + 
  labs(fill = "Year", color = "Year") +
  xlab(" ") + 
  ylab("Survival") + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(24, 21), name = "Method", labels = c("Electrofishing", "Screw trap"))
  
  
  
```

```{r}
#summarize number of tags per release group and number of detections per site by year for parr tagging
#2021 - 2025

lgr <- c('GRJ', 'GRS', 'LGRRRR') #s = spillway, #j = juvenile bypass
down <- c("GOJ", "LMJ", "ICH", "MCJ", "JDJ", "B2J", "BCC",
          "PD5", "PD6", "PD7", "PD8", "PDO", "PDW", "TWX")
SC12 <- c('SC1', 'SC2') #pool detections at SC1 and SC2
LC12 <- c('LC1', 'LC2') #pool detections at LC1 and LC2
IR45 <- c('IR4', 'IR5') #pool detections at IR4 and IR5
IR12 <- c('IR1', 'IR2')



release_sites <- obs_tbl$release_site


year <- seq(2021, 2025, by = 1)

n_release_group <- map(ch_parr, ~ .x %>% 
  select(tag_code, obs_site, event_type, release_site) %>%
  filter(event_type == "Mark") %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(release_site) %>%
  count())

n_release_group_df <- bind_rows(n_release_group, .id = "year") %>%
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, -4))  %>%
  mutate(mpg = case_when(
    `release_site` %in% gri  ~ "Grande Ronde/Imnaha",
    `release_site` %in% sf_sal   ~ "SF Salmon",
    `release_site` %in% mf_sal ~ "MF Salmon",
    `release_site` %in% wet_clear    ~ "Wet Clearwater", 
    `release_site` %in% dry_clear ~ "Dry Clearwater")) 

n_release_group_wide <- n_release_group_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = n) %>%
  arrange(mpg)

mpg_group_count <- table(n_release_group_wide$mpg)
  
n_detect_site <- map(ch_parr, ~ .x %>%
  select(tag_code, obs_site, event_type, release_site) %>%
  mutate(obs_site = replace_when(obs_site, 
    obs_site %in% lgr ~ "LGR",
    obs_site %in% down ~ "Down", 
    obs_site %in% LC12 ~ "LC12", 
    obs_site %in% SC12 ~ "SC12", 
    obs_site %in% IR12 ~ "IR12", 
    obs_site %in% IR45 ~ "IR45"
    )) %>%
  filter(event_type != "Mark") %>% 
  filter(!(obs_site %in% release_sites)) %>%
  filter(obs_site %in% obs_sites) %>%
  select(tag_code, obs_site) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(obs_site) %>%
  count())

n_detect_site_df <- bind_rows(n_detect_site, .id = "year") %>%
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, -4))

n_detect_site_wide <- n_detect_site_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = n)


detection_timing <- map(ch_parr, ~.x %>%
  filter(event_type != "Mark") %>% #filter out marking events
   mutate(obs_site = replace_when(obs_site, 
    obs_site %in% lgr ~ "LGR",
    obs_site %in% down ~ "Down", 
    obs_site %in% LC12 ~ "LC12", 
    obs_site %in% SC12 ~ "SC12", 
    obs_site %in% IR12 ~ "IR12", 
    obs_site %in% IR45 ~ "IR45"
    )) %>%
  filter(obs_site %in% detection_df$site) %>%
  filter(!(obs_site %in% release_sites)) %>%
  select(tag_code, obs_site, first_obs, release_site, mark_release_date) %>%
  arrange(first_obs))

detection_timing <- map(detection_timing, ~.x %>%
  mutate(fish_num = 1) %>%
  group_by(release_site, obs_site) %>%
  mutate(cumul = cumsum(fish_num), 
         cum_prop = cumsum(fish_num)/sum(fish_num)))

emigration_timing_plot_list <- map(detection_timing, ~.x %>%
  filter(max(cumul) > 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = first_obs, y = cum_prop)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = release_site), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~obs_site, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_theme + 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey", color = "black"), 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
  ylab("Cumulative proportion") + 
  xlab("Date") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  scale_x_date(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  labs(color = "Release site"))

names(emigration_timing_plot_list) <- c("2021", "2022", "2023", "2024", "2025")

#emigration timing

plot_dropdown <- function(plot_list, label, caption,
                          width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150) {
  uid <- paste0("pd", sample.int(1e8, 1))
  nms <- names(plot_list)

  uris <- lapply(plot_list, function(p) {
    f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    ggsave(f, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
    base64enc::dataURI(file = f, mime = "image/png")
  })

  select <- tags$select(
    id = paste0(uid, "-select"),
    onchange = sprintf(
      "var s=this.value; document.querySelectorAll('.%1$s-plot').forEach(function(e){e.style.display=(e.id==='%1$s-'+s)?'block':'none';});",
      uid
    ),
    lapply(seq_along(nms), function(i) tags$option(value = i, nms[i]))
  )

  panels <- lapply(seq_along(uris), function(i) {
    tags$div(
      id = paste0(uid, "-", i),
      class = paste0(uid, "-plot"),
      style = if (i == 1) "display:block;" else "display:none;",
      tags$img(src = uris[[i]], style = "max-width:100%;")
    )
  })

  # One caption for the whole dropdown, in the format bookdown numbers
  cap <- tags$p(
    class = "caption",
    HTML(sprintf("(#fig:%s) %s", label, caption))
  )

  tags$div(class = "figure", select, panels, cap)
}

#travel timing

#We are pooling travel timing from all release groups to each reach
#this aligns with the decision to pool detection probabilities - we assume emigration timing is similar among release groups
#also increases the sample size a lot 
#we are separating by year

reaches <- survival_df %>%
  select(from_site, to_site) %>%
  distinct()

#some recaptures occurred at tagging site weeks later
#
travel_time <- map(ch_parr, ~ .x %>%
   mutate(obs_site = replace_when(obs_site, 
    obs_site %in% lgr ~ "LGR",
    obs_site %in% down ~ "Down", 
    obs_site %in% LC12 ~ "LC12", 
    obs_site %in% SC12 ~ "SC12", 
    obs_site %in% IR12 ~ "IR12", 
    obs_site %in% IR45 ~ "IR45"
    )) %>%
  select(tag_code, obs_site, first_obs, release_site, event, event_type) %>%
  arrange(tag_code, first_obs, event) %>%
  group_by(tag_code) %>%
  mutate(travel_time = first_obs - lag(first_obs)) %>%
  mutate(travel_time_day = seconds_to_period(travel_time)) %>%
  mutate(from_site = lag(obs_site), 
         to_site = obs_site) %>%
  filter(!is.na(travel_time_day))) 

travel_time_df <- bind_rows(travel_time, .id = "year") %>%
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, -4)) %>%
  right_join(reaches, by = c("from_site", "to_site"))

median_travel_time <- travel_time_df %>%
  group_by(from_site, to_site, year) %>% 
  mutate(travel_time = as.numeric(travel_time)/86400) %>%
  summarise(median = median(travel_time), 
            min = min(travel_time),
            q1 = quantile(travel_time, 0.25, na.rm = T),
            q3 = quantile(travel_time, 0.75, na.rm = T),
            max = max(travel_time),
            sample = length(travel_time))

surv_travel_time <- survival_df %>%
  left_join(median_travel_time, by = c("year", "from_site", "to_site")) %>%
  mutate(mort_day = (1 - phi)/median, 
         mort_ucl = (1 - lcl)/median,
         mort_lcl = (1 - ucl)/median)

travel_survival_fig <- surv_travel_time %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = median, y = phi)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = year), size = 4, shape = 21) + 
  plot_theme + 
  xlab("Median travel time (days)") + 
  ylab("Estimated reach-specific survival") + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 350)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis") + 
  labs(fill = "Year")
  

med_travel_time_dat <- surv_travel_time %>%
   mutate(mark_season = fct_relevel(mark_season, "Summer")) %>%
    unite(col = "int_label", from_site, to_site, sep = " to ", remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(interval = as.numeric(interval)) %>%
    mutate(int_label = fct_reorder(int_label, interval)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(median))

med_travel_time_plot_list <- med_travel_time_dat %>%
    mutate(mpg = as.character(mpg)) %>%
    group_split(mpg) %>%
    map(~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = reorder_within(int_label, interval, release_group), y = median)) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3, color = year), width = 0.1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, aes(fill = year), position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
    plot_theme +

```{r}
#distance between sites

mrr_meta <- queryMRRMeta()
int_meta <- queryInterrogationMeta()


years <- seq(2021, 2025, by = 1)

rkm_list <- vector("list", length(years))

activity <- "parr"

for (y in 1:length(years)) {

  tag_yr = years[y]

  file_df <- check_mark_groups_tag_yr(activity = activity, tag_year = tag_yr)

# we can only run survivals if we have interrogation or complete tag history information
  mark_groups <- file_df %>% filter(cth_exists)

  mark_df <- map_df(mark_groups$mark_file,
                    ~readRDS(file.path(file_path, .)))
  
  rkm <- mark_df %>%
    select(release_site, location_rkmext) %>%
    distinct() %>% 
    mutate(year = tag_yr)
  
  rkm_list[[y]] <- rkm
  
}

rkm_df <- bind_rows(rkm_list)

#most sites had pretty consistent tagging locations (>10 km difference among locations)
#exceptions are CATHEC, GRAND2, LOSTIR, WALLOR, MINAMR
# ggplot(rkm_df, aes(x = release_site, y = location_rkmext)) + 
#   geom_boxplot()

# rkm_df %>%
#   group_by(release_site) %>%
#   summarise(range = max(location_rkmext) - min(location_rkmext)) %>%
#   print(n = 35)

#take the mean 
rkm_ext <- rkm_df %>%
  group_by(release_site) %>%
  summarise(rkm_ext = mean(location_rkmext))

#pull rkm info from mrr_meta for complete list of sites of interest

#need to fix for combined arrays (IR12, LC12, SC12)
mrr_sites <- c(release_sites, obs_sites, lgr, IR12, LC12, SC12)

mrr_meta_filter <- mrr_meta %>%
  filter(siteCode %in% mrr_sites) %>%
  select(siteCode, name, rkm, type)

int_meta_filter <- int_meta %>%
  filter(siteCode %in% mrr_sites) %>%
  select(siteCode, name, rkm, siteType) %>%
  rename(type = siteType)

site_meta <- rbind(mrr_meta_filter, int_meta_filter)

#rkm_sum = distance from mouth of Columbia to river mouth for mrr sites, distance from mouth of columbia to int sites
site_meta <- site_meta %>%
  mutate(rkm_sum = sapply(strsplit(site_meta$rkm, ".", fixed = TRUE),
                            function(x) sum(as.numeric(x))))
  
site_meta <- site_meta %>%
  left_join(rkm_ext %>% rename(siteCode = release_site), by = "siteCode") %>%
  replace_na(list(rkm_ext = 0)) %>%
  mutate(total_rkm = rkm_sum + rkm_ext)

#take means to calculate distances for IR12, LC12, SC12

site_meta <- site_meta %>%
   mutate(siteCode = replace_when(siteCode,
    siteCode %in% LC12 ~ "LC12", 
    siteCode %in% SC12 ~ "SC12", 
    siteCode %in% IR12 ~ "IR12"
    )) %>%
  #fixing WR2 rkm based on text stating rkm is 32, not 21
  mutate(total_rkm = if_else(siteCode == "WR2", 955, total_rkm)) %>%
  group_by(siteCode) %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(name, rkm, type, rkm_sum, rkm_ext), first),
    total_rkm = mean(total_rkm),
    .groups = "drop")

#NOTE - DISTANCES THAT ARE NOT IN CONTINUOUS DOWNSTREAM PATH ARE WRONG
#survival estimates only exist for downstream migration pathways, so the additional pairwise distances are irrelevant

d <- dist(setNames(site_meta$total_rkm, site_meta$siteCode))   # absolute differences


# long format
pairwise_dist <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(d))) %>%
  rename(from_site = Var1, to_site = Var2, dist_km = Freq)

dist_surv <- survival_df %>%
  left_join(pairwise_dist, by = c("from_site", "to_site")) %>%
  mutate(mort_km = (1 - phi)/dist_km, 
         mort_ucl = (1 - lcl)/dist_km, 
         mort_lcl = (1 - ucl)/dist_km)

dist_survival_fig <- ggplot(dist_surv, aes(x = dist_km, y = phi)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = year), size = 4, shape = 21) + 
  plot_theme + 
  xlab("Reach length (km)") + 
  ylab("Estimated reach-specific survival") + 
  labs(fill = "Year") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 800)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis")

# ggplot(dist_surv, aes(x = mort_km)) + 
#   geom_histogram()
# 
# ggplot(dist_surv, aes(x = interval, y = mort_km)) + 
#   geom_boxplot()

dist_surv_dat <- dist_surv %>%
    mutate(mark_season = fct_relevel(mark_season, "Summer")) %>%
    unite(col = "int_label", from_site, to_site, sep = " to ", remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(interval = as.numeric(interval)) %>%
    mutate(int_label = fct_reorder(int_label, interval))

mort_km_plot_list <- dist_surv_dat %>% 
    mutate(mpg = as.character(mpg)) %>%

  map(~ ggplot(.x,aes(x = reorder_within(int_label, interval, release_group), y = mort_km*100)) + 
    #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mort_lcl*100, ymax = ucl*100, color = year), width = 0.1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, aes(fill = year, shape = mark_season), position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
    scale_x_reordered() +
    plot_theme + 
    facet_wrap_paginate(~fct_inorder(release_group), scales = "free", ncol = 3, nrow = 4, page = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22), name = "Season") +
    labs(fill = "Year") +  
     guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21)), linetype = "none") +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey", color = "black"), 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
          legend.position = "top") + 
    ylab("Mortality per km (%)") + 
    xlab(" ") + 
    ggtitle(unique(.x$mpg)))

names(mort_km_plot_list) <- c("Dry Clearwater", "Grande Ronde/Imnaha", "MF Salmon", "SF Salmon", "Wet Clearwater")

#calculate km/day

km_day <- dist_surv %>% 
  select(from_site, to_site, interval, dist_km, phi, year, mort_km) %>%
  left_join(travel_time_df, by = c("from_site", "to_site", "year")) %>%
  mutate(travel_time_numeric = as.numeric(travel_time)/86400) %>%
  mutate(km_day = dist_km/travel_time_numeric) %>%

median_emigration <- km_day %>%

travel_rate_survival_fig <- ggplot(median_emigration, aes(x = med_emigration, y = phi)) +

    ggplot(aes(x = int_label, y = km_day)) + 
    #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl, color = year), width = 0.1, linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, aes(fill = year), position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
    plot_theme + 
    facet_wrap_paginate(~fct_inorder(release_site), scales = "free", ncol = 4, nrow = 2, page = 2) +
    #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + 
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey", color = "black"), 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
    ylab("Survival") + 
    xlab(" ")
```
